target: 555 Monstra Illustrata

source: 555 Monster Illustrated
target: 555 Monstra Illustrata

source: It wasn’t until three tramps pointed revolvers at him that Lugano sprang into action.
target: Nisi postquam tres vagabundi in eum revolvera intendere coeperunt, Lugano ad agendum subito exsurgit.

source: As a seasoned bounty hunter, he had no time to discern where the assailants planned to shoot.
target: Ut venator peritus praedae, tempus non habebat ad perscrutandum quo hostes iaculaturos essent.

source: He pushed off with strength in his feet, swiftly lunging to the side.
target: Pedibus validis impulsus, celeriter ad latus se protulit.

source: He dodged two bullets, but the third one was too close, altering his trajectory
target: Duas globulas vitavit, sed tertia nimis prope erat, iter eius mutans.

source: —inevitably striking him.
target: —inevitabiliter eum percutiens.

source: In midair, Lugano did something unconventional.
target: In aere, Lugano rem insolitam egit.

source: Instead of curling up to shield vital spots, he extended his body, using his palm to shield his chest.
target: Pro cur se convolvere ad loca vitalia tuenda, corpus suum extendit, et palma pectoris munus tulit.

source: Bang!
target: Bum!

source: The bullet connected with his right rib, unleashing a vivid spray of blood.
target: Globulus costam dexteram eius percussit, vividam sanguinis effusionem edens.

source: With a thud, Lugano landed on the street, rolling forward to evade subsequent shots.
target: Cum strepitu, Lugano in platea cecidit, volvens ad ictus posteriores vitandos.

source: In the midst of his lunge, Lumian’s form materialized from the shadows by the roadside.
target: In medio impetu suo, figura Lumiani ex umbris iuxta viam apparuit.

source: He delivered a powerful punch to the tramp who had just fired.
target: Vagabundo, qui modo tela iaculaverat, ictum validum dedit.

source: With a resounding thud, the tramp’s eyes rolled back, and he crumpled, unconscious.
target: Cum strepitu sonoro, oculi vagabundi retrorsum voltabantur, et ipse corruit, inanimatus.

source: Lumian returned to the shadows and swiftly moved behind another tramp.
target: Lumian ad umbras rediit, et celeriter post alium vagabundum se contulit.

source: Before he could fire a second shot, Lumian punched him behind the ear.
target: Priusquam vagabundus alterum ictum iaculareret, Lumian eum post auriculam percussit.

source: As the tramp collapsed, Lugano skillfully evaded the second bullet fired by the remaining assailant.
target: Dum vagabundus corruit, Lugano callide secundum globulum a reliquo aggressore iaculatum vitavit.

source: In that tense moment, passersby and elderly women chatting on the street scattered, desperately seeking cover.
target: In illo momento angustae tensionis, transeuntes et senes feminae in platea colloquentes se disperserunt, refugium acriter quaerentes.

source: The surroundings seemed eerily vacant.
target: Ambitus insolitē desertus videbatur.

source: Shadows danced as Lumian emerged from the darkness beside the last assailant.
target: Umbræ saltabant dum Lumian ex tenebris iuxta ultimum aggressorem emergit.

source: Extending his right palm, he seized the other’s neck.
target: Dextram palmam extendens, cervicem alterius prehendit.

source: Almost simultaneously, the assailant’s mouth opened naturally, emitting a slender black shadow.
target: Paene simul, os aggressoris naturaliter aperiebatur, tenui nigro umbram efferens.

source: An insect, as thick as a finger, with tentacle-like bristles floating on its body, lunged straight for Lumian’s neck.
target: Insectum, digito crasso, cum setis tentaculosis in corpore suo fluitantibus, directe ad Lumiani cervicem impetum fecit.

source: “Hmph!”
target: Hem!

source: Two pale-white beams of light flickered in Lumian’s nostrils.
target: Duo radii pallido-albi lucis in naribus Lumiani micabant.

source: The slender, peculiar black insect lost its strength, gently descending into his raised left palm.
target: Insectum tenuem et insolitum nigrum vim amisit, leniter in palmam sinistram elevatam descendens.

source: As anticipated… Lumian withdrew his right hand from the tramp’s neck, unfazed.
target: Ut praedictum erat... Lumian dextram manum a vagabundi cervice abstulit, imperturbatus.

source: The tramp’s eyes returned to normal.
target: Oculi vagabundi ad statum consuetam redierunt.

source: Clutching his revolver, he staggered backward, leaning against the wall before slumping to the ground in a daze.
target: Revolverum tenens, retro titubavit, ad parietem inclinatus, deinde in terram languide cadens.

source: Lumian paid him no heed.
target: Lumian eum non curavit.

source: Utilizing the shadows, he swiftly approached an unconscious tramp, noticing a small, bloodless wound on the back of his cervical spine.
target: Utens umbris, celeriter ad vagabundum inanimatum accessit, parvum vulneris, sine sanguine, in dorso colli eius notans.

source: Another slender, bristle-covered black insect darted out, attempting escape.
target: Alter insectum nigrum, tenuis et setis indutum, exsilit, effugere conans.

source: Lumian’s hand, engulfed in crimson flames, seized it.
target: Manus Lumiani, in flammis coccineis ardentibus, illud rapuit.

source: After a few struggles, the insect emitted a cooked fragrance.
target: Post paucas conatus, insectum odorem coctum effudit.

source: Subsequently, Lumian employed a similar method to handle the strange black insect emerging from another tramp’s body.
target: Postea, Lumian eandem rationem ad tractandum insolitum insectum nigrum ex corpore alii vagabundi emergentem adhibuit.

source: During this procedure, Lugano half-squatted on the street, his left palm flickering with a clear light as he pressed it against the gunshot wound on his right rib.
target: Interim, Lugano in platea ad dimidium genu flectens sedebat, palmo sinistro luce clara micante, illam contra vulnera telorum in costa dextra premens.

source: The charred wound immediately contracted, ceasing to ooze blood.
target: Vulnus exustum statim contraxit, sanguis effluere desinens.

source: Drawing a dagger, Lugano skillfully “picked” a yellow bullet from the wound with precision and efficacy.
target: Acuto sumpto, Lugano peritia “extraxit” globulum flavum ex vulneri, cum subtilitate et efficacia.

source: With that accomplished, he generated a faint light in his left palm, pressing it against the wound.
target: Hoc confecto, lumen tenuissimum in palmo sinistro gignit, et illud contra vulnera premens.

source: The injury squirmed and swiftly fused, reducing to a fifth of its original size in no time.
target: Vulnus contortus celeriter adunatus est, statim ad partem quintam originis redactus.

source: Lugano had intentionally stretched, hoping the bullet would hit a spot he could conveniently handle!
target: Lugano se proposito extendit, sperans globulum in locum incidere, quem facile administrare posset!

source: As he retrieved a bandage to tend to the remaining wound, Lumian approached, extending his free right palm.
target: Dum fascia ad reliquum vulnerum curandum acciperet, Lumian accessit, dextram manum liberam extendens.

source: Understanding his employer’s gesture, Lugano returned the Lie earring, expressing relief, “Fortunately, I’m a Doctor. As long as I’m not killed on the spot, gunshot wounds aren’t a big deal.”
target: Comprehendens gestum datori suo, Lugano restituit monile “Lie”, levamen exprimens: “Felix, medicus sum. Dummodo in situ non occidar, vulnera telorum parva sunt.”

source: Silently, Lumian donned the silver Lie earring.
target: Tacite, Lumian monile argenteum “Lie” inductus est.

source: Leaning down, he pressed and swiped at Lugano’s wound, transferring it to the back of his right hand.
target: Inclinans se, vulnera Lugani premens et circumactans, eam in dorsum dextrae manus transferuit.

source: Due to the disparity in location and Lugano’s pre-treatment, the wound regressed into a small scrape—one akin to scraping against a rough wall.
target: Ob diversitatem locorum et praeviam curationem Lugani, vulnus in parvam laniationem rediit, similem ad repugnationem contra parietem asperum.

source: “…” Lugano stared at the wound that didn’t even require a bandage, falling into a prolonged silence.
target: “…” Lugano vulneri intuens, quod ne fascia quidem requirebatur, in longam silentii statum cecidit.

source: Lumian smiled and remarked, “Why else do you think I let you carry Lie?”
target: Lumian subridens dixit: “Quare aliud putas me te portare Lie permissurum esse?”

source: “…” Lugano gaped, uncertain of what to say.
target: “…” Lugano attonitus stetit, nesciens quid diceret.

source: Surveying the area, Lumian instructed, “Take the three tramps’ guns and wait for the police to arrive.
target: Ambitum percepit, Lumian praecepit: “Accipe arma trium vagabundorum et exspecta adventum vigilum.”

source: Report that you were attacked.
target: Narrā quod aggressus es.

source: After giving your statement, if there’s nothing else, take Ludwig to the Fertility Order’s entrance and have them uphold justice and maintain order in Port Santa.”
target: Postquam relationem dederis, si nihil aliud, Ludwig ad introitum Ordinis Fertilitatis ducas, et iustitiam servare ac ordinem in Portu Santa conservare iube.

source: “Alright, alright.” Lugano hurriedly stood up.
target: “Bene, bene.” Lugano festinanter surrexit.

source: Just as he took two steps toward the dazed tramp, realization struck.
target: Dum duo gradus ad vagabundum obnubilatum fecit, repente intellectus eum percussit.

source: He turned around and blurted, “What about you? Where are you going?”
target: Se vertit et exclamavit, “Quid de te? Quo vadis?”

source: In his haste, he had forgotten to use honorifics.
target: In festinatione, honores verba non adhibere oblitus erat.

source: Lumian simply chuckled, saying nothing.
target: Lumian leviter risit, nihil dicens.

source: I sent you to the Fertility Order to inform them of my intentions—to let them know!
target: Te ad Ordinem Fertilitatis misi ut de propositis meis eos certiores facerem—ut notum faceres!

source: Lumian proceeded towards Solow Motel, leaving crimson flames in his wake that incinerated the blood dripped by Lugano.
target: Lumian versus Solow Motel processit, relinquens flammas coccineas in vestigiis, quae sanguinem a Lugano stillantem combusterunt.

source: As he advanced, Lumian lowered his voice and asked, “Temiboros, do you recognize these insects?”
target: Dum processit, Lumian vocem demittit et quaesivit: “Temiboros, agnoscisne haec insecta?”

source: Termiboros remained silent.
target: Termiboros tacuit.

source: Upon reaching the suite on the fifth floor, Lumian observed Ludwig eagerly awaiting him.
target: Ad conclave in quinto tabulato perveniens, Lumian Ludovicum animo avido eum exspectantem observavit.

source: His heart stirred as he spread his left palm, revealing three black insects.
target: Cor eius concitato, palmo sinistro extendens, tres insecta nigra ostendit.

source: Casually, he inquired, “Do you know what these are?”
target: Levis animo, quaesivit: “Scisne quid haec sint?”

source: Ludwig nodded obediently, speaking swiftly, “Batings Black Insect, a creature from Planet Heveen 3.”
target: Ludwig obediebili modo annuens celeriter locutus est: “Insectum Nigrum Batings, creatura ex Planeta Heveen 3.”

source: Rich in various proteins and possessing high energy levels.
target: Divitis variis proteinis et altis viribus energeticae praeditum.

source: They invade human bodies via the cervical spine, controlling their nervous systems to manipulate them to their advantage.
target: Corporibus humanis per spina cervicali invadunt, nervorum systemata regentes ut ipsos ad suam utilitatem gubernent.

source: These Batings Black Insects ceased evolving generations ago.
target: Hi Insecta Nigra Batings generationes abhinc evolvere desierunt.

source: While controlling the nervous system, the host’s movements stiffen, and their eyes roll back.
target: Regendo systema nervosum, motus hospitis rigidantur, et oculi retrorsum vertuntur.

source: They seldom directly kill the host, but their larvae, once laid, absorb the host’s energy, indirectly leading to their demise.
target: Raro hospitem directe interficere solent, sed larvæ eorum, semel positae, energiam hospitis absorbunt, et ita ad ipsorum exitium ducunt.

source: In ancient times, many of their ancestors received boons.
target: Antiquitus, multi maiorum eorum beneficia recepērunt.

source: Though their descendants no longer possess these, their body structures adapted to the boon’s power were inherited, eventually evolving into this special species with minor Beyonder-level powers.
target: Quamquam posteri eorum haec iam non possident, sed structurae corporales, dono potentiae accommodatae, hereditate obtentae, tandem in hanc speciem specialem cum parvis viribus Beyonder similis evolutae sunt.

source: Consider it a special spirit world creature or a degenerated Beyonder creature.
target: Id considera creaturam ex mundo spirituum specialem vel creaturam Beyonder degeneratam.

source: After the long explanation, Ludwig gazed at Lumian longingly, asking, “That’s all I have to say. Can I eat them now?”
target: Post longam expositionem, Ludwig Lumianum desiderio intuentem interrogavit: “Hoc tantum habeo dicendum. Possumne ea nunc edere?”

source: You really know… You make it sound so real.
target: Scis vere… Illud tam verum sonare facis.

source: The Batings Black Insect, Planet Heveen 3.
target: Insectum Nigrum Batings, Planeta Heveen 3.

source: What’s happening… The alien planets Aurore mentioned?
target: Quid fit... Planetæ extranei quos Aurore memoraverat?

source: Lumian was taken aback.
target: Lumian obstupuit.

source: Lumian wasn’t surprised that Ludwig had the desire to consume the Batings Black Insects.
target: Lumian non miratus est quod Ludwig desiderium edendi Insecta Nigra Batings haberet.

source: This guy could even gnaw on live rats!
target: Hic etiam muribus viventibus roere poterat!

source: The insects even emitted a rather pleasant fragrance after being roasted.
target: Insecta etiam odorem satis iucundum emiserunt postquam torrefacta sunt.

source: Lumian stared at Ludwig for a few seconds before handing over the three Batings Black Insects in his hand.
target: Lumian per paucos secundos in Ludovicum intuebatur, antequam tria Insecta Nigra Batings in manu ei tradidit.

source: Ludwig didn’t hide his delight.
target: Ludovicus gaudium suum non celavit.

source: He swiftly devoured two of the roasted insects, relishing the explosion of juices in his mouth.
target: Celeriter duas ex insectis torrefactis devoravit, gustans explosionem succorum in ore suo.

source: He half-closed his eyes, and an unusual fluctuation seemed to surge within him.
target: Semicis oculos clausit, et fluctus insolitus intus in eo quasi exarsit.

source: Lumian furrowed his brow in confusion but refrained from intervening.
target: Lumian frontem contraxit confusus, sed intervenire coartatus est.

source: Having used the Mystery Prying Glasses to discover that there appeared to be something beneath Ludwig’s skin, coupled with Ludwig’s daily behavior and the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom’s stance, Lumian speculated that the boy was a monster in human guise, sealed by the Church to carry out tasks inconvenient for deploying clergymen.
target: Utendo Speculis Arcanis ad detegendum quasi aliquid sub cute Ludovici latere, necnon ex more cotidie agendi Ludovici atque positione Ecclesiae Dei Cognitionis et Sapientiae, Lumian coniecerit puerum esse monstrum sub specie hominis, a Ecclesia sigillatum ad officia incommoda pro clericis exsequenda.

source: Regarding the Reader pathway controlled by the Church of the God of Knowledge and Wisdom, it held various applications at the Body of Heart and Mind level.
target: Quoad viam Lectorem a Ecclesia Dei Cognitionis et Sapientiae regendam, illa varia usus habebat in gradu Corporis, Cordis atque Mentis.

source: It was reasonable to assume why Ludwig’s mind had suffered damage after being sealed, rendering him seemingly foolish.
target: Rationabiliter putabant cur mens Ludovici post sigillum laesus esset, ita eum quasi stultum reddens.

source: After 20 to 30 seconds, Ludwig opened his eyes and rushed to the dining table.
target: Post viginti ad tricenam secundis, Ludwig oculos aperuit et ad mensam ientaculi festinavit.

source: Grabbing a small steel table knife, he carefully placed the remaining Batings Black Insect on the tablecloth and skillfully cut it open, removing numerous black fascias.
target: Parvum cultellum ex ferro mensale arripiens, reliquum Insectum Nigrum Batings super linteum mensae diligenter posuit et arte secavit, plures fascias nigras removens.

source: Ludwig poured a glass of Manzan and arranged the fascia and the shell of the Batings Black Insect on the table, adding the black juice squeezed from the insect’s body.
target: Ludwig poculum Manzan effudit et fasciam atque testam Insecti Nigri Batings in mensa disposuit, addens sucum nigrum ex corpore insecti exprimitum.

source: Lumian observed as the pale-golden liquor swiftly transformed into a dark-red, almost black hue, emitting dense bubbles.
target: Lumian intuens, liquamen pallido-aureum celeriter in colorem rubrum paene nigrum mutatum et densas bullas emittere incipit.

source: Once the bubbles subsided, Ludwig lifted the peculiar cocktail.
target: Postquam bullae defecerunt, Ludwig potum mixtum insolitum sustulit.

source: Only then did he remember Lumian’s presence.
target: Tum tantummodo memor fuit praesentiae Lumiani.

source: Stammering, he asked, “Can I —can I drink a little?”
target: Balbutiens, quaesivit: “Possumne—possumne paulum bibere?”

source: A sealed Body of Heart and Mind indeed… Lumian smiled and sighed.
target: Certe Corpus Cordis ac Mentis sigillatum… Lumian subridens et suspirans dixit.

source: “Drink up.”
target: “Bibe.”

source: Gulp! Gulp! Ludwig finished the small amount of dark-red nearly black liquor and expressed satisfaction to Lumian, saying, “After concocting the Batings Black Insect’s bodily fluids, it can enhance the physique of those who drink it for the first time to a certain extent.
target: Guttus! Guttus! Ludwig parvum modum liquaminis obscuri-rubri, paene nigri, finivit, et satisfactionem suam Lumiano exprimit: “Postquam fluidis corporis Insecti Nigri Batings concoctis, id figuram illorum qui primum bibunt ad aliquem modum augere potest.

source: It grants everyone the ability to paralyze primate creatures within two hours.
target: Omnibus dat facultatem creaturas primatas intra duas horas paralysare.

source: Yes, it will only be effective through contact.
target: Ita, tantum per contactum efficax erit.

source: Th-this is turning the Batings Black Insect into something akin to charms?
target: Ha—hoc Insectum Nigrum Batings in aliquid simile talismanis redigit?

source: Moreover, it provides permanent effects and short-term Beyonder powers…
target: Praeterea, effectus permanens et breves potentias Beyonder offert…

source: Amidst Lumian’s surprise, he sensed that Ludwig had undergone significant changes.
target: Inter stuporem Lumiani, sensit Ludovicum mutationes significantes passi esse.

source: He had never demonstrated the ability to prepare such food before!
target: Numquam antea facultatem ad talia edulia praeparanda ostensum habuerat!

source: Lumian didn’t delve deeper and calmly remarked, “Take Lugano to the Fertility Order’s entrance later and ensure he informs Noelia about the attack.”
target: Lumian non ulterius intravit et tranquille dixit: “Postea Lugano ad introitum Ordinis Fertilitatis ducas, et curare ut Noelia de impetu certiorem fiat.”

source: “Alright.” In a good mood, Ludwig readily agreed.
target: “Bene.” Ludwig, bono animo, facile consentivit.

source: Meanwhile at the port district—while Ludwig and Lugano arrived at the Fertility Order.
target: Interea in regione portuaria—dum Ludwig et Lugano ad Ordinem Fertilitatis pervenissent.

source: Wearing a golden straw hat, Lumian strolled towards the square dominated by an Ocean Waves statue.
target: Gerens pileum stramineum aureum, Lumian ad forum, quod statua Undarum Oceanorum dominabatur, ambulavit.

source: His attention focused on the grayish-black house adorned with the Port Santa Fisheries Guild’s sign.
target: Animus eius ad domum fuscovirilis ornata signo Societatis Piscatoriae Portus Santae intendit.

source: The four- or five-story castle-like ancient structure was rumored to be over a millennium old, having been destroyed and rebuilt centuries ago.
target: Structura antiqua, castelli similis, quattuor aut quinque tabulata, fama erat plus mille annos nata, quondam deleta et saeculis refecta.

source: Lumian’s eyes traced the intricate symbols on the wall, which included iron hooks and fishing nets.
target: Oculi Lumiani symbola intricata in pariete secuti sunt, quae includebant hamulos ferreos et rete piscatorium.

source: Adjusting his straw hat, he proceeded towards the Fisheries Guild.
target: Pileum stramineum aptans, ad Societatem Piscatoriam processit.
